title: A repair marker replaces one prior field value
summary: A narrow repair hypothesis assigns a marker the function of revising exactly one immediately preceding field; the subsequent field should use the replacement value.

design.unit: records containing a prior field, repair marker, and replacement/restatement
design.prediction: A repair marker should be followed by one replacement that differs from the prior field, while later fields retain the repaired value and are not independently rewritten.
design.countermodel: Editorial correction or omitted context could create the same pattern without a repair or hedge operator.
design.falsifier: The marker leaves the prior value active, rewrites multiple earlier fields, or changes a later field without a replacement.
design.principal_risk: Independent correction annotations are unavailable. Near operator and exception families, but the restriction is one retroactive target plus one replacement.
